messages:
Noah (CSM): Quick sync — Solstice renewal is due next Tue. They want to move to a 9-month term and asked for PO SOL-9001. Procurement also asked for a short training window within 10 business days of sign.
Elena (AM): Sales approved a one-time 10% concession for 9mo to keep them from churning. Confirming proc is ok with PO referencing amended term.
Priya (Legal): Fine with 9mo, will prepare a short amendment (prorate + termination notice). Need to add a clause: "no auto-renew" and clarify billing entity.
Marco (Finance): We need billing entity + VAT/EIN before issuing invoice. We can do Net30. If they want split billing, we'll need two POs.
Noah (CSM): Procurement said single PO SOL-9001 will reference their US subsidiary. They asked: can we show pro rata line items on the invoice?
Marco (Finance): Yes, we can show pro rata lines. I'll draft invoice and attach once PO arrives.
Sam (Enablement): For training — can deliver a 2-hour condensed workshop and a follow-up office hours session. Can we lock dates within 48h of signature?
Elena (AM): Request: include a one-page ROI snapshot in the envelope; they requested examples during renewal conversation.
Noah (CSM): @Sam can you produce an anonymized ROI mock + agenda by EOD tomorrow?
Sam (Enablement): Yep — ROI mock + 2hr agenda by EOD tomorrow.
Noah (CSM): Sending DocuSign with draft amendment + draft invoice (pending PO) and ROI sample link.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope env_solsign_1822 created and sent to procurement@solstice.com (status: sent).
Priya (Legal): If procurement redlines, ping me. I'll handle counter language (esp. around billing entity and termination).
Elena (AM): If signing stalls >72h, consider offering a one-time implementation credit on next renewal to close. Keep me posted.
Noah (CSM): Updated renewals tracker: status=waiting_on_signature, risk=medium, notes=9mo term approved; invoice draft prepared; training requested within 10 business days. Will follow up with procurement in 3h. /cc @Elena (AM) @Priya (Legal) @Marco (Finance) @Sam (Enablement)
